svg.title: The 30-block student before and after healing
svg.desc: Left: 32 slots, 30 original blocks plus attention bridges in slots 5 and 20. Middle: healing trains a rank-16 LoRA on the attention projections of the 30 blocks together with both bridges, then merges each LoRA into its weight matrix. Right: the same 32 slots with fused blocks and fine-tuned bridges, with no extra weights.

g.text: The 30-block student: before healing, and after healing with the LoRA fused
Blocks 5 and 20 are replaced by attention bridges; the other 30 blocks keep their original architecture.
Trained together, end to end against
• LoRA rank 16 on q, k, v, out of each
Every checkpoint saved; each judged by
velocity and by the spelling grids.
Same shape and cost as before:
the LoRA adds no weights and
Teacher: 32 blocks × 218.1M. Student: 30 blocks + 2 bridges = 385.8M fewer weights (about 5.6%), about 1.05× faster per step.
During healing only: + 15.7M LoRA weights (trainable, with the 50.4M of the bridges). After fusing: exactly the size of the left column.
Later, removals three and four are chosen inside the healed student, and the speed-distillation (lightning) LoRA,
trained last for about 5× fewer steps, is fused the same way before quantization.
